errors.evidence: The description omits the full purpose of the chart, which is to show the "Share of primary sector products in total trade" (Дял на продуктите на първичния сектор в общия стокообмен), as stated in the caption. It only mentions "percentage share of products".
The description incorrectly states that the labels on the X-axis (the years) are written vertically. In the figure, they are written horizontally.
